verdict.rationale: A state business-filing office is a fair place to ask whether filing deadlines and late-penalty and interest schedules are published with exact figures, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes that hit bot walls (Akamai 403, Incapsula interstitials). It holds no content about deadlines, penalty amounts or interest schedules, so there is no evidence the story is delivered. Confidence is low because the lack of evidence comes from blocked access, not from a documented absence.
